name: Integrated Fault-Tolerant Flight Control Simulation Benchmark
description: A simulation benchmark to evaluate integrated fault-tolerant flight control systems across a range of simulated faults and operational scenarios.
reputation: A specialized aerospace control simulation benchmark from the flight-control research community; referenced in fault-tolerant control literature but not widely used outside that niche.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark based on simulation; results are highly dependent on simulator fidelity and fault models. Dataset/benchmark instances may be small and domain-specific; not standardized across modern toolchains.
